text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I remember right, it was a race that 
Nice Nature was once all fired up to run 
in, vowing to defeat Tokai Teio, but—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, well, when I realized the absolute 
best Nature was gonna run, I just couldn't 
sit still—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
What's that all about~ Look at you saying 
such adorable things.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sure you remember, but today, I'm 
coming at you with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I won't go easy on you either, 
so keep that in mind!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! I'll challenge Nature with 
everything I've got, too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Give it your all today, okay!
